# ايكوال المحاسبي (Equal Accounting)

> ايكوال المحاسبي هو برنامج محاسبة سطح مكتب للمحلات يعمل بدون إنترنت. Equal Accounting is an Arabic-first, offline Windows desktop accounting and point-of-sale app for small shops in Egypt and the Arab world. Shop data stays on the shop's own computer.

## What it is
- Category: accounting software, point of sale (POS), inventory management
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktop app; works fully offline
- Language: Arabic, right-to-left interface
- Data: stored locally on the shop's main computer; other cashier PCs connect over the shop's local network (no external server)
- Pricing: free trial, no mandatory monthly subscription

## Key features (facts)
- Tax invoices with VAT, tax-inclusive prices by default; discount order: line discount, then invoice discount, then VAT
- POS with shifts, barcode scanning, held sales, X report, cash in/out
- Inventory: weighted-average cost, periodic stock counts with review, adjustments, batches and expiry dates, branch transfers
- Purchases: purchase orders, partial receiving, purchase returns and debit notes
- 28 ready-made reports: trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, aging, VAT, stock and sales reports
- 14 automatic accounting integrity checks on the ledger
- Roles and permissions (cashier, accountant, storekeeper, manager), manager approvals, full audit log
- Multi-branch, cost centers, multi-currency
- Encrypted automatic backups saved wherever the user chooses
